stem: In Pavlovian terms, an unconditioned stimulus (UCS) is which of the following?

options.label: A
options.misconception: Biochem — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: B
options.text: A tumor-suppressor protein such as p53
options.misconception: Biochem — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: C
options.text: A neutral cue with no biologic pull at first
options.misconception: CS starts neutral; UCS is biologically evocative.
options.explanation: Opposite; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.misconception: Operant terminology — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong paradigm; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Something that elicits a reflexive response
options.misconception: None; UCS elicits a reflexive response.
options.explanation: OpenStax: UCS elicits a reflexive response in an organism.

imageCaption: Classical associates stimuli; operant uses consequences; observational learning models others.
